summary: Owner-edited plan (2026-09-02) from run enterprise-hardening-mtklhiqp-ot3jz9. Edits: CSP delivered via _headers only with connect-src from VITE_* vars; SES eager lockdown downgraded to a spike; dev-bridge bearer token dropped in favour of origin allowlist + 127.0.0.1 bind; SSRF + MCP HTTPS guards moved from ws-05 into ws-03 so ws-05 is a focused SSO/gateway/zero-BYOK lane (M, not L); destructive-op code-string guard labelled as a guardrail, not a security control. 8 workstreams, 3 waves.

WebLLM / local in-browser WASM model execution (YAGNI — enterprise policy requires corporate LLM gateway routing for auditing, DLP, and compliance).
Complex OAuth PKCE desktop loopback proxy (YAGNI — production enterprise users authenticate via Office SSO Entra ID tokens; consumer OAuth is dev-only).
Real-time multi-user document collaboration in VFS (YAGNI — Office taskpanes run in isolated user browser/WebView context and native Office handles document co-authoring).

steps: In packages/sdk/src/provider-config.ts, introduce isEnterprise check (import.meta.env.VITE_APP_MODE === 'enterprise'). In eval_officejs (Excel) and execute_office_js (Word), add a destructive-op guardrail (allowDestructiveOps: false by default) that rejects code containing .delete()/.clear()/worksheet deletion.
